<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Sohan Rana — AI & Human-Centered Technology</title>
<meta name="description" content="Sohan Rana — Software Engineering professional-in-training focused on AI, HCI, NLP and responsible technology. Dhaka, Bangladesh."/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#070c18; --bg2:#0b1324; --panel:#0f192e; --panel2:#132039;
  --line:rgba(160,185,230,.12); --text:#eaf0fb; --muted:#93a3c0;
  --blue:#5b9dff; --blue2:#8ec0ff; --gold:#d9b872; --gold2:#f0d9a3; --mint:#5ad6c0;
  --serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; --mono:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;position:relative;z-index:2}
section{position:relative;padding:110px 0;z-index:2}

/* animated background */
.mesh{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.mesh i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(110px);opacity:.5;animation:float 22s ease-in-out infinite}
.mesh i:nth-child(1){width:560px;height:560px;background:#1d4fd8;top:-160px;right:-120px;opacity:.28}
.mesh i:nth-child(2){width:480px;height:480px;background:#b8903f;bottom:-120px;left:-140px;opacity:.16;animation-delay:-8s}
.mesh i:nth-child(3){width:380px;height:380px;background:#139e8a;top:45%;left:48%;opacity:.12;animation-delay:-14s}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(50px,-40px) scale(1.08)}66%{transform:translate(-40px,40px) scale(.94)}}
.grain{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:64px 64px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#000 30%,transparent 80%)}
.glow{position:fixed;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(91,157,255,.13),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);left:-999px;top:-999px;transition:opacity .3s}
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--gold));z-index:100}

/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:90;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,padding .3s;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
nav.scrolled{background:rgba(7,12,24,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-color:var(--line)}
.nav-in{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;transition:padding .3s}
nav.scrolled .nav-in{padding:12px 32px}
.logo{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.logo i{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#2f6be0);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:1rem;color:#fff}
.links{display:flex;gap:26px;list-style:none}
.links a{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .2s}
.links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-2px;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--gold);transition:width .3s}
.links a:hover,.links a.on{color:var(--text)}
.links a:hover::after,.links a.on::after{width:100%}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,background .25s,border-color .25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn-fill{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#3a78ee);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(59,120,238,.3)}
.btn-fill:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(59,120,238,.45)}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1f08;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(217,184,114,.22)}
.btn-line{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.btn-line:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2)}

/* hero */
#hero{padding:150px 0 90px;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mint);padding:7px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(90,214,192,.3);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(90,214,192,.07);margin-bottom:26px}
.eyebrow b{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(90,214,192,.6)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(90,214,192,0)}}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,7.4vw,5.8rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:14px}
h1 span.g{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--blue2),var(--gold2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;background-size:200% auto;animation:shine 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes shine{to{background-position:200% center}}
.role{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.7vw,1.15rem);color:var(--gold2);min-height:1.8em;margin-bottom:20px}
.role .caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.1em;background:var(--gold);vertical-align:-3px;margin-left:3px;animation:blink 1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.lead{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:580px;margin-bottom:32px}
.lead strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}
.cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:46px}
.stats{display:flex;gap:42px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.2rem;line-height:1.1;color:var(--text)}
.stat span{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em}

.portrait{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:430px;margin-left:auto;perspective:900px}
.pframe{position:relative;border-radius:220px 220px 30px 30px;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(91,157,255,.7),rgba(217,184,114,.5) 55%,rgba(90,214,192,.2));box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 90px rgba(91,157,255,.18);transition:transform .15s ease-out;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.pimg{position:relative;border-radius:210px 210px 20px 20px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5.1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 28%,#2a4a86 0,#122244 55%,#0a1428 100%)}
.pimg img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
/* photo mode: background-heavy snapshot, zoomed on the person and blended into the palette */
.pimg.snap img{width:190%;height:auto;max-width:none;left:50%;top:-4%;transform:translateX(-47%);filter:saturate(.9) contrast(1.05)}
.pimg.snap::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,34,68,.55) 0%,rgba(18,34,68,.15) 40%,rgba(10,20,40,.55) 100%);mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.pimg.snap::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 58%,transparent 38%,rgba(7,12,24,.65) 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 70%,rgba(7,12,24,.8));pointer-events:none}
/* cutout mode: transparent PNG over the designed backdrop */
.pimg.cut img{object-fit:contain;object-position:50% 100%;width:112%;left:-6%;top:0;height:104%;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35));animation:breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.012)}}
.pimg.cut::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 24%,rgba(91,157,255,.35),transparent 55%);pointer-events:none}
.ring{position:absolute;inset:-26px -22px -22px -26px;border:1px dashed rgba(217,184,114,.35);border-radius:240px 240px 44px 44px;z-index:-1;animation:spin 40s linear infinite reverse}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ring{animation:none}
.chip{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(12,22,42,.9);border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-size:.8rem;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);animation:bob 6s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:3}
.chip small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.64rem}
.chip.c1{left:-44px;bottom:90px}
.chip.c2{right:-22px;top:46px;animation-delay:-3s}
.chip.c3{right:-10px;bottom:30px;animation-delay:-1.5s}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}

/* marquee */
.strip{border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);overflow:hidden;position:relative;z-index:2}
.track{display:flex;gap:46px;width:max-content;padding:17px 0;animation:slide 40s linear infinite;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.track span::before{content:'◆';color:var(--gold);margin-right:46px;font-size:.55rem;vertical-align:middle}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* headings */
.kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.kicker::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.2vw,3.1rem);letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:22px;max-width:780px}
h2 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:500;color:var(--blue2)}
.sec-sub{color:var(--muted);max-width:640px;margin-bottom:46px}

/* about */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:28px}
.card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:32px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .35s,transform .35s,box-shadow .35s}
.card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(500px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(91,157,255,.12),transparent 45%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
.card:hover{border-color:rgba(91,157,255,.4);transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem}
.card p+p{margin-top:14px}
.card strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}
.fact{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.side{display:grid;gap:16px;align-content:start}
.side .card{padding:22px 26px}
.big{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.3}
.exploring{margin-top:22px;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(217,184,114,.28);background:rgba(217,184,114,.06);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--gold2)}
.exploring b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;display:block;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:4px}

/* interests */
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.ic{font-size:1.7rem;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(91,157,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(91,157,255,.25);margin-bottom:18px;transition:transform .4s}
.card:hover .ic{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1)}

/* work */
.work{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1.1fr 1.5fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:start;padding:36px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .35s,padding .35s;position:relative}
.row::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;height:1px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--gold));transition:width .6s}
.row:hover{background:rgba(91,157,255,.04);padding-left:26px}
.row:hover::after{width:100%}
.num{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--gold);font-size:.82rem;padding-top:10px}
.row h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:8px}
.tag-k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--mint);letter-spacing:.07em}
.row p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.acts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end}
.pill{font-size:.76rem;text-decoration:none;padding:8px 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;transition:all .25s}
.pill:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);transform:translateX(-3px)}
.status{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(90,214,192,.1);color:var(--mint);white-space:nowrap}
.status.am{background:rgba(217,184,114,.12);color:var(--gold2)}

/* engagements */
.eng{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.eng .card:first-child{grid-row:span 2;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(91,157,255,.16),var(--panel))}
.eng .loc{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mint);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.eng .when{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.64rem;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(217,184,114,.4);color:var(--gold2)}

/* skills */
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.sk h3{font-size:.76rem;font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px}
.sk ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.sk li{font-size:.83rem;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:all .25s}
.sk li:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sk li.now{border-color:rgba(90,214,192,.4);color:var(--mint)}
.legend{margin-top:18px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
.legend span{color:var(--mint)}

/* education / timeline */
.tl{position:relative;margin-left:10px;padding-left:38px}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--line)}
.tl .fill{position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;width:1px;height:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--blue),var(--gold))}
.ev{position:relative;padding-bottom:34px}
.ev:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.ev::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-45px;top:8px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(217,184,114,.1)}
.ev time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold)}
.ev h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.35rem;margin:4px 0 6px}
.ev p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;max-width:660px}

/* writing */
.write{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:start}
.posts{display:grid;gap:14px}
.post{display:block;padding:22px 26px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border:1px solid var(--line);transition:all .3s;position:relative}
.post:hover{border-color:rgba(217,184,114,.45);transform:translateX(6px)}
.post .meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.post h4{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.post p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;white-space:pre-wrap}
.post .del{background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:.72rem;font-family:var(--mono)}
.post .del:hover{color:#ff8c8c}
.composer{position:sticky;top:90px}
.composer h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.composer .hint{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px}
.composer input,.composer textarea,.composer select{width:100%;background:rgba(7,12,24,.6);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:12px;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.composer input:focus,.composer textarea:focus,.composer select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(91,157,255,.12)}
.composer textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}
.composer .note{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;font-family:var(--mono)}

/* contact */
.cta-box{border-radius:30px;padding:60px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(91,157,255,.18),rgba(217,184,114,.08));border:1px solid rgba(91,157,255,.28);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cta-box::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(217,184,114,.18),transparent 65%);right:-80px;top:-100px;animation:float 14s ease-in-out infinite}
.cta-box h2{margin-bottom:16px}
.cta-box p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.mail{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.3vw,1.6rem);color:var(--gold2);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(217,184,114,.45);word-break:break-all}
.soc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.soc a{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(7,12,24,.55);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s;font-size:.88rem}
.soc a small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.64rem;margin-bottom:2px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.soc a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px)}
footer{position:relative;z-index:2;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:30px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem;font-family:var(--mono)}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.totop{position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--gold2);display:grid;place-items:center;text-decoration:none;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .3s;z-index:80}
.totop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}

/* reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);transition-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal.left{transform:translateX(-40px)}.reveal.right{transform:translateX(40px)}
.reveal.left.in,.reveal.right.in{transform:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .links{display:none}
  .hero-grid,.about-grid,.write,.cta-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .portrait{margin:0 auto;max-width:360px}
  .grid3,.skills{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .eng{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.eng .card:first-child{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:auto}
  .row{grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:14px 18px}
  .row p,.row .acts{grid-column:2}.acts{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start}
  .cta-box{padding:38px 26px}.composer{position:static}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .wrap,.nav-in{padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
  section{padding:76px 0}#hero{padding-top:120px}
  .grid3,.skills,.eng{grid-template-columns:1fr}.eng .card:first-child{grid-column:auto}
  .chip.c1{left:-8px}.chip.c2{right:-4px}.chip.c3{display:none}
  .stats{gap:28px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="progress" id="progress"></div>
<div class="mesh"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><div class="grain"></div><div class="glow" id="glow"></div>

      <p>I am a Software Engineering <strong>professional-in-training</strong> with a growing focus on Artificial Intelligence, Human-Computer Interaction, Natural Language Processing, and responsible technology. My interests lie at the intersection of technology and human needs, particularly in exploring how intelligent systems can be designed to be useful, accessible, ethical, and meaningful.</p>
      <p>My journey began with software development and practical problem-solving through academic and personal projects. Over time, my curiosity has expanded toward research-driven areas of AI and human-centered computing. I enjoy learning through hands-on projects, exploring research questions, experimenting with emerging technologies, and turning ideas into practical solutions.</p>
      <p>Alongside my academic and technical interests, I actively participate in national and international conferences, youth forums, workshops, and collaborative initiatives. These experiences have allowed me to engage with participants from diverse backgrounds, exchange ideas, learn from researchers and practitioners, and develop a broader understanding of technology, climate action, society, and global challenges.</p>
      <p>I am currently strengthening my knowledge in AI, NLP, HCI, AI Ethics, and data-driven technologies, with a particular interest in research and projects that address real-world challenges. I aim to contribute to technology that is not only innovative, but also responsible, inclusive, and human-centered.</p>

<script>
(function(){
  /* ---- EDIT THIS LIST to publish posts for every visitor ---- */
  var POSTS=[
    {t:"What is Human-Centered AI?",c:"AI & Research",d:"Coming soon",b:"Why AI systems should be designed around human needs and decision-making."},
    {t:"NLP for the Bangla Language",c:"NLP",d:"Coming soon",b:"Notes on working with a low-resource language, from my BanglaJobGuard research."},
    {t:"Why AI Ethics Matters",c:"AI Ethics",d:"Coming soon",b:"Fairness, transparency, privacy and accountability in the systems we build."},
    {t:"What I Learned from RCOY APAC 2026",c:"Climate & Society",d:"Coming soon",b:"Takeaways from meeting young people across the Asia-Pacific."}
  ];

  var $=function(s){return document.querySelector(s)},$$=function(s){return [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(s))};
  var reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* typed role */
  var roles=["AI & HCI Enthusiast","Exploring NLP, AI Ethics & Human-Centered Technology","Researcher in the making","Co-founder & COO, Honqio IT"],ti=0,ci=0,del=false,el=$('#typed');
  function tick(){var w=roles[ti];
    if(reduce){el.textContent=roles[0];return}
    el.textContent=w.slice(0,ci);
    if(!del&&ci<w.length){ci++;setTimeout(tick,55)}
    else if(!del){del=true;setTimeout(tick,1600)}
    else if(ci>0){ci--;setTimeout(tick,28)}
    else{del=false;ti=(ti+1)%roles.length;setTimeout(tick,300)}}
  tick();

  /* reveal + counters */
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.12});
  $$('.reveal').forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
  $$('[data-count]').forEach(function(n){var to=+n.dataset.count,t0=null;
    function f(ts){if(!t0)t0=ts;var p=Math.min((ts-t0)/1200,1);n.textContent=Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)));if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)}
    setTimeout(function(){requestAnimationFrame(f)},700)});

  /* scroll: progress, nav, active link, timeline, totop */
  var secs=$$('section[id]'),links=$$('.links a');
  function onScroll(){var h=document.documentElement,st=h.scrollTop,max=h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight;
    $('#progress').style.width=(st/max*100)+'%';
    $('#nav').classList.toggle('scrolled',st>30);
    $('#totop').classList.toggle('show',st>700);
    var cur='';secs.forEach(function(s){if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<160)cur=s.id});
    links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+cur)});
    var tl=$('#tl'),r=tl.getBoundingClientRect(),p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(innerHeight*.7-r.top)/r.height));
    $('#tlfill').style.height=(p*100)+'%'}
  addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});onScroll();

  /* cursor glow + card spotlight + photo tilt */
  addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var g=$('#glow');g.style.left=e.clientX+'px';g.style.top=e.clientY+'px'});
  $$('.card').forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px');c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px')})});
  var tilt=$('#tilt');
  tilt.parentNode.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){if(reduce)return;var r=tilt.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;tilt.style.transform='rotateY('+(x*10)+'deg) rotateX('+(-y*8)+'deg)'});
  tilt.parentNode.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){tilt.style.transform=''});


  /* blog */
  function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
  function mine(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sr_posts')||'[]')}catch(e){return[]}}
  function render(){var m=mine(),h='';
    m.slice().reverse().forEach(function(p,i){var idx=m.length-1-i;
      h+='<div class="post"><div class="meta"><span>'+esc(p.c).toUpperCase()+' · '+esc(p.d)+'</span><button class="del" data-i="'+idx+'">delete</button></div><h4>'+esc(p.t)+'</h4><p>'+esc(p.b)+'</p></div>'});
    POSTS.forEach(function(p){h+='<div class="post"><div class="meta"><span>'+esc(p.c).toUpperCase()+'</span><span>'+esc(p.d)+'</span></div><h4>'+esc(p.t)+'</h4><p>'+esc(p.b)+'</p></div>'});
    $('#posts').innerHTML=h;
    $$('.del').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){var m=mine();m.splice(+b.dataset.i,1);try{localStorage.setItem('sr_posts',JSON.stringify(m))}catch(e){}render()}})}
  $('#pub').onclick=function(){var t=$('#pt').value.trim(),b=$('#pb').value.trim();if(!t||!b){$('#pt').focus();return}
    var m=mine();m.push({t:t,b:b,c:$('#pc').value,d:new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'})});
    try{localStorage.setItem('sr_posts',JSON.stringify(m))}catch(e){}
    $('#pt').value='';$('#pb').value='';render()};
  render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
